name: shell_side_htc
title: Shell-side heat-transfer coefficient: Kern, Donohue and Bell-Delaware with J corrections (function library)
summary: Twenty-two EES FUNCTIONs for the shell-side heat-transfer coefficient of a shell-and-tube exchanger: crossflow areas and hydraulic diameter, the Kern and Donohue coefficients, and the Bell-Delaware method (ideal-bank Colburn factor from the tabulated a1..a4 coefficients, the factors Jc, Jl, Jb, Jr, Js computed from the geometry for 0, 45 and 60 degree layouts, and the assembled h). Translation of LaboThapPy shell_and_tube_htc.py; the demo reproduces the source example and 12 further cases, and exposes two probable source slips (Smax parenthesis, Jr product instead of power) with a method flag.

verification.summary: Source re-run (LaboThapPy f03f7f47 in a virtualenv, CoolProp 8.0.0): Kern and Bell-Delaware of the source example plus 12 layout/flow cases and their intermediates, 47 values, 0 differ at rtol 1e-9, max deviation 3.5e-13. J factors agree with CSL-0103; Kern areas recomputed analytically. Donohue is a repaired call (source crashes).
verification.reference: Python re-run of labothappy/correlations/convection/shell_and_tube_htc.py (commit f03f7f47): __main__ example and 12 further cases, local variables captured; patched copy for method 2 and the repaired Donohue; CSL-0103 functions; hand calculation of Kern areas
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 47 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=1e-09). The source function shell_htc_donohue raises a TypeError, so its reference is a repaired re-implementation with the source's own s_max. No handbook or paper value of h was checked.
